kinds: painted metal pedestrian railing at crossings and subway mouths

evidence.buildings.floors: sheet cp_outer_circle 'Buildings': two storey ring, 8 to 20 storey glass and concrete towers beyond; the 90th percentile of 12 is an estimate for the towers that stand inside this area's outer edge
evidence.buildings.upkeep: sheet cp_outer_circle 'Footpaths' (more broken sections) and 'Typical clutter and wear' (works hoardings, dust on signs, patches show)

evidence.lamps: sheet cp_outer_circle 'Street lamps': the same steel double-arm poles as the inner ring plus taller highmast lamps at the major junctions, light sodium orange at night
